Ruling: batch #398 item 1 · letter A′ · maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-26T14:02Z

Recorded by the director seat (summon #51 continuation, `session_01KrKXQVvgYk2AJ4VkqMobyb`, ledger objectstack#12708, brief 6417215677). The maintainer asked in the summon chat whether the two North Star documents should be merged into one; the seat answered no — two readers (the fleet and the maintainer; third-party developers), two venues (a Tier H repository file; a published docs page linked by five site pages), different languages — and put forward **A′**, which the maintainer accepted with 「同意」:
1. `content/docs/concepts/north-star.mdx` is renamed `architecture-overview` (a redirects-ledger entry, `check:docs-redirects` green) and keeps its stable sections — Principles, Runtime Shape, Environment Artifact, Request Resolution, Non-Goals; its **Built** and **Drift To Keep Shrinking** sections are removed: they are status that drifts and duplicates the ladder in `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`.
2. AGENTS.md Prime Directive 8 ("Read `content/docs/concepts/north-star.mdx` before structural changes … §7 Built, shrink Drift, or unlock Missing") is re-pointed at `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`'s 路上的功能点 ladder; AGENTS.md:7, CONTRIBUTING.md:69 and ROADMAP.md:4 all name `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` as the one North Star; the five site pages that link the mdx move to the new slug.
3. `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` gains an English summary section under the Chinese text (the four opening questions, the one measure, how to read the ladder); the Chinese original is not edited.
Not B (the priority ladder would lose the name every seat uses) and not C (two names stay).

Workload of the chosen letter (card column): devx · 1 PR Tier H (`AGENTS.md`, `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`; plus `ROADMAP.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `content/docs/concepts/`, `content/docs/meta.json`, the redirects ledger, the five linking pages), serialized after #26035 (open, `pm:dispatched`, edits AGENTS.md).

Execution: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` in this act (`domain:docs` as triage graded, p2); `pm:awaiting-maintainer` removed in the same stroke. `Ruling-ref:` names this comment; `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`; the dev greps README, `ui/` and the docs redirects for `concepts/north-star` before renaming (the card's confidence gap).
